QuestInfo.name: The Heart of Darkness
QuestInfo.0: Talk with Feng and enter the Devil Clan's base.
QuestInfo.1: Despite the narrow entrance, the cave system was quite expansive, with a multitude of enemies inside. But you can't stand down! Push forward!
QuestInfo.2:
As you struggled with the number of enemies in the deceptively expansive cave system, you heard the voices of Xiao Xiao and the other students. 
Xiao Xiao was disappointed that you didn't trust them, and you will now share the burden instead of taking it all upon yourself. 
You had forgotten how you could get simply having someone else watch your back. Still, you can't leave all of the work to the pupils! Push on for just a bit longer!
